title: woodsia glabella subsp. pulchella
intro: Woodsia glabella subsp. pulchella, commonly known as the veined woodsia, is a species of fern belonging to the family Woodsiaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, digestive issues, and skin conditions. The veined woodsia is also known to exhibit therapeutic actions like calming the nervous system, promoting relaxation, and reducing stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
